summary: Verified Cebraspe logo replacement across all 6 flow pages. /cebraspe-logo.webp served with HTTP 200, Content-Type image/webp, 6886 bytes. All 6 pages (termos, inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao, pagamento-pix, inscricao-realizada) contain inside #cebraspe-topbar .ceb-logo. Image loads successfully with naturalWidth=212, naturalHeight=50 (essentially 211x50 as specified - 1px decode variance). Desktop height computed = 44px (spec mentioned 46px but files_of_reference show inline style 44px which matches). Mobile height computed = 40px as required. The original hand-drawn SVG and Cebraspe were fully removed from the DOM in these pages (not just display:none) — cleaner result than spec required. inicio.html uses the same webp asset embedded as a data URI (background-image on img.normal), so visual identity is preserved. Screenshots confirm identical logo design (orange pencil crossing blue arc + Cebraspe wordmark) on both desktop and mobile.

issues: Desktop img height computed as 44px (inline style) even though the CSS rule inside

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align desktop logo height to 46px by removing inline style="height:44px" on so the CSS rule (46px) applies. Otherwise all functionally correct.
critical_code_review_comments: Inline style height:44px on the overrides the CSS 46px rule - minor inconsistency between spec and implementation.
SVG and span were removed rather than hidden via display:none — cleaner outcome, no risk of visual conflict.
